messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: HIGH - model-catalog-service - bad-config-promotion fired (incident id: PD-4821)
incident-bot: Trigger: catalog-promotion-job promoted rev=rev_2026_03_11 to default for model: rdlw-m-13b, reported 500s and tokenizer mismatch errors in routing logs

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-4821 auto-paged kim (oncall) -> escalation policy: eng-oncall -> 2 min -> mike

kim (oncall): ack - looking
kim (oncall): logs show upstream validation failures from model-router: "tokenizer: unknown|mismatch" and downstream responses 502/500 to prod clients
kim (oncall): impact: elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate for rdlw-m-13b route, spike started ~2111112200 (≈13m ago)

mike: on it, pulling catalog revision diff
mike: diff shows promotion changed default_tokenizer to "tok_v3" but the model variant in runtime still expects "tok_v2". config propagation lag + no compatibility check = bad defaults

priya: tagging customer-impact. Any known customers on pinned older variants?
laura: customer A (enterprise-xyz) uses a model alias that routes to rdlw-m-13b default; they reported degraded quality and errors in last 10m

kim (oncall): immediate mitigation options: 1) revert promotion in catalog (fast) 2) patch model-router to accept tok_v3 as alias (risky) 3) route traffic to previous stable variant (rdlw-m-13b@rev_2026_03_03)

mike: I'll roll back the catalog promotion now. Command:```
# rollback promotion
catalogctl promote --model rdlw-m-13b --revision rev_2026_03_03 --force --reason "auto-rollback PD-4821"
```

mike: running now, watching propagate to control plane cache
incident-bot: catalogctl: promotion request submitted (op id: op-8842)

kim (oncall): @mike keep an eye on autoscaler interaction, we don't want a reconcilation loop creating conflicting revisions

mike: confirmed op-8842 accepted. Pushing a broadcast to model-router to pick up new default cache flush:```
curl -X POST "https://router-api.redwood.internal/v1/admin/flush-default-cache" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rdlw-m-13b"}'
```

mike: flush returned 200; router reports new default rev=rev_2026_03_03 loaded on 8/10 nodes

priya: I'm messaging support and account exec for enterprise-xyz, telling them we're rolling back and investigating. ETA for service normalization?
kim (oncall): Expecting error rate to fall in ~30-60s after full propagation. If not, we'll route to fallback variant at infra layer.

laura: customer-xyz confirms errors dropping, but quality still odd (some tokens missing). Might be partial traffic still hitting old config

mike: checking logs: token mismatch 5xx rate decreased from 4.8% -> 0.7% in last 3m. Latency normalized for most requests.

pagerduty-bot: PD-4821 acknowledged by kim (oncall) at 2111112250

kim (oncall): escalation to mike cancelled. Thanks everyone.

priya: collecting affected request counts: preliminary numbers: ~1.2k failed requests in 15m window, top affected customers: enterprise-xyz (360 reqs), beta-pilots (210 reqs), unknown/anonymous (rest)

mike: adding a short-term guard in catalog pipeline to block promotions where default_tokenizer changes without a runtime-compatible flag. Patch discussed on PR: https://git.redwood/rdlw/catalog/pull/312

kim (oncall): assign postmortem owner? mike can you own rollback and mitigation summary? priya you'll do customer comms?

mike: I can own the postmortem. Will include timeline, root cause (catalog promotion with incompatible tokenizer), why compatibility check didn't catch it, and remedial actions (pre-promotion validation, rollback automation, and routing fallback policy)

priya: I'll draft customer notes and share with laura + support. Will request sentiment and compensation recs if needed.

laura: FYI SRE will add a synthetic test hitting /v1/generate with a tokenization check for default variants to catch this before promotion.

kim (oncall): incident state -> mitigated, PD incident still open for write-up. Next: create follow-up ticket for promotion gating + catalog schema validation + monitoring alert for tokenizer mismatch metric

mike: created infra ticket INF-2748 for promotion gating and added link: https://issues.redwood/INF-2748

priya: emailing impacted customers now (initial message) — will send either a final update or apology depending on feedback

kim (oncall): thanks all. If any lingering errors or new spikes, re-alert in thread. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PD-4821 status updated -> mitigated (auto-note: rollback applied and traffic reverted to rev_2026_03_03)

sre-rotation: adding postmortem meeting invite for 2111112350-2111120000 UTC, owners: mike, kim, priya, laura

kim (oncall): closing on-call for this thread, handing off to postmortem owners. Good job triaging quickly."
